shortcuts_see_guide: See full guide →  How to Use
settings_hint_quit_on_close: When enabled, × closes the app instead of minimizing to tray.
settings_hint_start_with_windows: Launch automatically when you log in.
settings_placeholder_output_folder: Default — same directory as source file
settings_hint_naming: Controls how converted/processed files are named. Placeholders: {name} (source stem), {ext} (target extension), {date} (YYYYMMDD), {datetime} (YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS).
settings_hint_cookies_file: Export your browser cookies to a .txt file using the “Get cookies.txt LOCALLY” extension (Chrome/Brave/Edge/Firefox), then select it here. Log into Instagram first, then export from instagram.com.
settings_hint_cookies_browser: Browser must be closed or unlocked. May fail on Brave/Chrome due to OS-level cookie encryption. Ignored if a cookies file is set above.
settings_hint_spotify: The default spotdl credentials are shared and rate-limited. Create a free app at developer.spotify.com → set Redirect URI to http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback (required by Spotify but never used) → paste your Client ID and Secret below.
settings_placeholder_spotify_id: Leave blank to use spotdl default (rate-limited)
settings_placeholder_spotify_secret: Leave blank to use spotdl default (rate-limited)
settings_hint_ytdlp: Update the download engine to the latest version.
welcome_body:
Looks like this is your first time here.

Head over to How to Use in the sidebar to get up to speed with all the features — downloading, converting, trimming, and more.
welcome_hint: Look for the glowing icon in the sidebar.
tool_download_desc:
Download videos, audio, playlists
from 1000+ websites.
tool_convert_desc:
Convert videos and audios
to any format.
tool_compress_desc:
Compress videos and images
without quality loss.
tool_merge_desc:
Merge multiple videos into
one seamless output.
tool_trim_desc:
Trim and cut videos to your
desired length.
tool_mux_desc:
Mix multiple audio tracks
like a pro.
tool_spatial_desc:
Resize, crop, and rotate
video files.
tool_scrub_desc:
Strip GPS, timestamps and
EXIF data from media.
tool_chunk_desc:
Split files by duration
or size (stream copy).
tool_watermark_desc:
Stamp logos or text across
an entire directory.
tool_frame_grabber_desc:
Extract lossless frames as
PNG or 16-bit TIFF.
tool_palette_desc:
Analyze dominant colors and
export hex swatches.
tool_bg_eraser_desc:
Remove backgrounds from
photos offline with AI.
dep_error_ffmpeg:
FFmpeg was not found on this system.

Media conversion, trimming, and download features will not work.

Install FFmpeg and add it to your system PATH, or place ffmpeg.exe in the same directory as this application.

Download from: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
dep_error_status: FFmpeg not found — some features unavailable.
settings_hint_ext_bridge: Listen on a local port for video URLs sent by the Videl browser extension. Loopback only — never exposed on the network.
settings_hint_ext_install: Click to open the extension folder. In your browser, open chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions), enable Developer mode, click 'Load unpacked', and select the folder.
ext_install_dialog_body:
The extension folder is open in File Explorer:

{path}

In your browser:

1. Open chrome://extensions  (Edge: edge://extensions)
2. Toggle 'Developer mode' ON (top-right).
3. Click 'Load unpacked' and select the folder above.
4. The 'Download with Videl' button will appear over videos on any page.

Firefox: open about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox → 'Load Temporary Add-on' → pick manifest.json inside that folder.

Keep Videl running so the extension can talk to it.
ext_bridge_port_busy: Browser extension bridge could not start (port in use).
ext_url_received_with_src: Received URL from browser extension (direct media also detected).
tray_running_body: Running in the background. Click the tray icon to restore.
status_drop_no_section: Could not determine target section for dropped files.
hero_subtitle:
All-in-one media toolkit for creators.
Fast. Simple. Powerful.
tools_page_subtitle: Select a tool to get started.
hdr_image_files: IMAGE FILES  (drag here or click Add)
ph_first_video: Same directory as first video file
ph_vid_to_split: Video or audio file to split…
ph_each_source: Same directory as each source file
hint_browse_formats: Browse a file to see available formats.
hint_browse_compress: Browse a file to see compression options.
hint_quality_lower: Lower = better quality, larger file  ·  28 is a good default
hint_preset_smaller: Slower = smaller file at same quality
hint_playlist_quality: Quality matched by resolution across all selected videos — formats loaded from first video.
hint_save_alongside: Leave blank to save alongside the source video.
hint_accepts_img_vid: Accepts images (JPG, PNG, WEBP…) and video files.
dyn_no_ops: No operations — click a button above.
lbl_history_empty: No history yet — completed operations will appear here.
tut_welcome_body: A desktop tool for downloading, converting, trimming, compressing, merging, transforming, watermarking, scrubbing metadata, chunking, and managing media files. Navigate with the sidebar on the left. This guide explains each section.
hdr_video_files_list: VIDEO FILES  (drag to reorder — top = first)
hdr_frame_preview: PREVIEW  —  scrub to the frame you want to grab
hint_watermark_output: Files saved with _watermarked suffix. Leave blank to save alongside originals.
hint_save_alongside_src: Leave blank to save alongside the source video.
ph_url_services: YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Twitch…
hint_check_formats_download: Click "Check Formats" to see available resolutions for the URL.
hint_preview_cdn_expire: Preview links from Facebook / Instagram / LinkedIn expire quickly — use Reload if playback stalls.
tooltip_reload_preview: CDN preview links expire — click to re-fetch a fresh URL.
hint_hw_gpu_encoder: GPU encoder — faster encode, slightly lower quality ceiling
hint_compress_nvenc_hint: p1 = fastest · p7 = best quality — file size controlled by QP, not preset
hint_compress_amd_hint: Tradeoff between encode speed and compression
hint_spatial_no_file_preview: No file loaded — browse a video or image above.
hint_spatial_crop_xy: X=0, Y=0 starts from top-left corner. Use the aspect ratio preset to auto-fill crop dimensions.
hint_spatial_rotate_ops: Each click adds to the sequence — preview updates live. Click Reset to start over.
hint_mux_replace_shortest: Output stops at whichever stream ends first (FFmpeg -shortest flag). If the audio is longer than the video, the extra audio is discarded.
hint_mux_add_mix: The video's original audio is preserved. The added audio is mixed on top. Output length matches the video — any extra audio is discarded.
hint_fg_scrub_use_frame: Scrub the preview above to your target frame, then click "Use this frame" — or type a timestamp manually.
note_fg_tiff_precision: 16-bit TIFF preserves sub-byte luminance precision for HDR and RAW workflows.
tooltip_fg_stamp_frame: Set the timestamp input below to this exact position
warn_fg_no_multimedia:
PySide6.QtMultimedia not installed — video preview unavailable.
Enter the timestamp manually below.
hint_palette_use_frame_tooltip: Extract palette from this exact frame only
hint_palette_reset_tooltip: Revert to analyzing the full video (slower)
hdr_palette_preview: PREVIEW — scrub to the frame whose colors you want
hint_palette_quantization: FFmpeg palettegen selects dominant colors via median-cut quantization. Click any swatch to copy its hex code.
hint_bg_result_placeholder: Run the eraser to see the result here.
hint_bg_source_formats: Accepts JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP. Output is always a PNG with transparent background. First run downloads the AI model (~170 MB) and caches it locally.
hint_scrub_intro: Add media files to scrub. All GPS coordinates, timestamps, camera info, and EXIF tags will be removed using FFmpeg stream copy (no quality loss).
hint_scrub_output: Scrubbed files are saved with a _clean suffix. Leave blank to save next to the originals.
hint_chunk_stream_copy: Both modes use stream copy — no re-encoding. Cuts are keyframe-accurate, so actual segment boundaries may vary slightly.
hint_enc_preset_hw_none: Slower = smaller file at same quality
hint_enc_preset_hw_amd: Tradeoff between encode speed and compression
hint_enc_preset_hw_intel: Slower = smaller file at same quality
tooltip_gif_start_s: Start offset in seconds from the beginning of the video
warn_trim_large_file: ⚠  Large file (>4 GB) — trimming may be slow.
warn_trim_no_mm:
ℹ  PySide6.QtMultimedia is not installed — video preview unavailable.
You can still trim by entering start/end times manually.
hint_trim_ripple: Mark segments to cut out. The parts around them will be joined seamlessly.
hint_trim_insert: Insert a video clip into the source video at a specific timestamp. Both videos will be re-encoded (H.264 / AAC) to ensure compatibility.
bug_reporter_page_subtitle: Found something wrong? Tell us about it. We'll look into it as soon as possible.
bug_reporter_ph_desc: Describe what happened, what you expected, and steps to reproduce…
bug_reporter_ph_email: your@email.com — so we can follow up
hint_vocal_source_formats: Supported: MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, M4A, OGG, MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WEBM
warn_vocal_cpu_time: Studio-Quality AI Processing: May take 2–5 minutes on CPU.
dyn_vocal_processing: Separating vocals (first run downloads ~300 MB model)…
err_vocal_no_input: Select a valid audio or video file.
tool_vocal_isolator_desc:
AI 2-stem separation:
isolate vocals from music.
hint_upscaler_source_formats: Supported: PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP, BMP, TIF, TIFF
hint_upscaler_tile: Smaller tiles use less VRAM but are slower. Use 256 for 4–8 GB GPUs, 512 for 12 GB+, Off only for small images.
warn_upscaler_cpu_time: Real-ESRGAN on CPU is slow (minutes per image). GPU recommended.
dyn_upscaler_processing: Upscaling image (first run downloads ~64 MB weights)…
lbl_model_upscaler_desc: The image upscaler model (Real-ESRGAN + torchvision, ~185 MB) is not installed. PyTorch is reused from the Vocal Isolator install. Pick the variant that matches Vocal Isolator (CUDA → CUDA, CPU → CPU).
lbl_model_upscaler_needs_demucs: Install the Vocal Isolator first — Real-ESRGAN reuses its PyTorch (CUDA or CPU) so you don't redownload ~3 GB.
tool_pdf_toolkit_desc:
Compress, merge, split PDFs
and extract images.
err_pdf_merge_min_files: Add at least 2 PDF files to merge.
hint_vocal_preset: Fast: quick pass, good for previews. Balanced: default. Quality: fine-tuned model, best results but slower.
lbl_model_rembg_desc: The background removal model (rembg, ~170 MB) is not installed on this machine.
lbl_model_demucs_desc: The vocal isolation model (demucs, ~300 MB) is not installed on this machine.
lbl_model_installing: Installing… this may take a few minutes
install_banner_message: This feature needs additional AI components installed for your account.
install_variant_cuda_no_gpu: No NVIDIA GPU detected. CUDA install requires an NVIDIA card.
install_variant_cuda_old_gpu: Your GPU is too old for the bundled CUDA 12.8 build (Maxwell GTX 9xx and Pascal GTX 10xx are not supported). CPU install will work.
install_error_network: Network error during install. Check your connection and retry.
install_error_disk: Not enough free disk space. Need ~{required_mb} MB on {target}.
install_error_permission: Permission denied writing to {target}. Run once as the same user that launched Videl.
install_interrupted_toast: Previous install was interrupted and rolled back. Retry?
install_needs_reinstall_toast: AI components need reinstalling — running in background.
tool_jumpcut_desc:
Auto-remove silent gaps from
audio and video.
hint_jumpcut_intro: Detects silent gaps with FFmpeg silencedetect, then re-encodes the file keeping only the loud parts.
hint_jumpcut_protected: Time ranges that must be kept intact — silence inside them will NOT be removed. Use the player to scrub, then click 'Mark In' / 'Mark Out' (or use the Set buttons on each row) to capture timestamps from the current playhead.
tip_jumpcut_mark_in: Start a new protected range at the current playhead
tip_jumpcut_mark_out: Set the end of the last protected range to the current playhead
